patterns.name: tool-permission-authority
patterns.summary: Enforce agent authority with tool restrictions rather than prompt text alone.

patterns.name: builder-auditor-separation
patterns.summary: Use a separate agent/model to audit work produced by another agent.

patterns.name: shared-durable-memory
patterns.summary: Use one durable shared knowledge surface across multiple agent runtimes while preserving provenance.

patterns.name: persistent-cron-operations
patterns.summary: Schedule recurring read, triage, and operational tasks with bounded credentials and change detection.

patterns.name: mobile-operator-surface
patterns.summary: Use mobile/PWA/iOS/Android surfaces for approvals, status, steering, and bounded commands.

patterns.name: skill-emergence-with-gate
patterns.summary: Convert repeated successful workflows into candidate skills, but require evaluation and signed promotion before authorization.

patterns.name: runtime-rollback
patterns.summary: Maintain reversible checkpoints for file/system changes and restore both workspace and execution context after failures.

patterns.name: signed-tool-verification
patterns.summary: Verify tool identity, integrity, declared capabilities, and publisher provenance before invocation.

patterns.name: local-first-runtime
patterns.summary: Prefer local/self-hosted execution where appropriate while preserving isolation, reproducibility, and operator control.

patterns.name: cost-aware-routing
patterns.summary: Route deterministic work to scripts/local models and reserve higher-cost models for ambiguity and synthesis.

patterns.name: market-evidence-not-orders
patterns.summary: Market/trading workflows may produce evidence and recommendations; execution authority remains separately gated.
